Everything was great initially. It holds up well, is comfy, inexpensive,  etc. After a few uses it has a mildew-y smell. Water get trapped in the elastic and it cant dry. I've washed it in the washing machine with bleach. It helps but a few uses later the same is back. I threw it out because it grosses me out to wear.
I have short hair so it works for me. It you have long hair it might be too small. The fit is snug but may stretch out after wearing it more.

reviews.t: Prettiest Shower Cap I Have Ever Had!
reviews.x: The sender was very fast.  The product does not disappoint.  At least not much.  It is definitely the prettiest shower cap I have ever had.  It is very well made.  It is a bit small for my long hair.  And I am hoping the elastic stretches out a bit.  Overall I am very pleased.
This shower cap is awful. It’s extremely small and my hair always ends up wet. I have purchased several shower caps on amazon and this is the worst one yet. It feels like it should be for a child.

reviews.t: Fashionable and Functional in the Same Cap
reviews.x: This shower cap is great.  It fits tight without being uncomfortable, so I don't have water running down my face.  The fabric is substantial so it is easy to put on and take off.  I like that it is fashionable because so many shower caps are not very attractive.  When I am treating my hair and need to leave in the treatment for 30 minutes, I am not embarrassed to answer the door.
Keeps the hair dry and the elastic keeps it snuggly in place.  Very6 comfortable.

I use this shower cap when I deep condition my hair. I have to use a folded cloth, inserted between the elastic and the back of my neck as the water from my hair constantly is dripping down my back as I wait to wash out my deep conditioner. But I mean, it's a cheap like ten buck shower cap and does seem to be waterproof, if you're trying to keep your hair dry, but it doesn't keep wet hair from leaking.

It may be water resistant but it’s not waterproof. The elastic edge allows a great deal of water in around the edge, so if you want to keep your hair dry while showering, keep your head out of the shower spray. It’ll work great then.

I usually have to use a dryer for a few seconds just on the little bit at the back of my neck which is better than a lot of others I have tried. I will buy this one again when it wears out.

The elastic part that is supposed to cling on your head is inside the really thick waterproof material. Since it is so thick, it is uncomfortable and also cannot lay flat against your head leaving big gaps where the water can just fly in. Oh well.

This showercap failed after only 2 months of sporadic use. I have very short cropped hair and a small head so it’s not like it was remotely stretched to its limit.  The elastic snapped and it’s completely unusable now.  Quality is poor. Waiting to see if customer service will rectify. I will update the review after I hear from them.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cap too small, especially for long or thick hair, and some say it leaves marks or lets hair get wet.
Several reviewers report water leaking in around the elastic edge, so it does not keep hair fully dry.
A common complaint is that the elastic area traps water and develops a mildew or moldy smell over time.
Reviewers frequently praise the cap as comfortable, well-made, and attractive or fashionable.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including the elastic breaking or stretching out.
